sentences.quote: Mr. Miller joined Halliburton in 1997, working in various leadership roles of increasing responsibility and oversight, including serving on our Board of Directors since 2014. From 2014 to 2017, he served as President and Chief Health, Safety and Environment Officer. From 2017 to 2018, Mr. Miller served as President and CEO; beginning in 2019, he has served as Halliburton's Chairman of the Board, President and CEO.
sentences.text: Jeffrey A. Miller is Chairman of the Board, President and Chief Executive Officer of Halliburton, having joined the company in 1997 and served in leadership roles of increasing responsibility, including on its Board of Directors since 2014; he was President and Chief Health, Safety and Environment Officer from 2014 to 2017, President and CEO from 2017 to 2018, and has served as Chairman, President and CEO since 2019.

Earlier roles at the company included Chief Operating Officer, Senior Vice President of Business Development, Regional Vice President of Gulf of Mexico, and Operations Vice President of Angola and Indonesia.

sentences.quote: Mr. Miller has extensive experience leading energy industry business efforts in every region of the world, including specific assignments living in Angola, Indonesia, Venezuela, and Dubai. He leads Halliburton's strategy and direction.
sentences.text: He has led energy industry efforts across every region of the world, with assignments living in Angola, Indonesia, Venezuela and Dubai, and sets Halliburton's strategy and direction.
